scope: Independent per-owner collider slots, typed geometry and activation, lifetime, clone/reference remapping, canonical callbacks and shared-body owned CPU/Wasm integration. Real Inspector edits and exact Stop restoration pass. Bounded existing solver; no PhysX numerical/GPU/full mesh cooking or automatic compound mass-property parity.

checks: collider instances retain distinct identities, geometry and activation
collider references publish exact logical slots
collider reference reads restore the selected sibling
clone retains both collider instances and independent shape state
clone remaps a reference to the second collider
canonical physics callbacks preserve collider and contact point identity
separate collider manifolds produce independent stay events
trigger changes produce separate exit and enter events
destroying the primary collider retains additional collider identity
extra-only collider owners still receive physics events
owner layer changes update every remaining collider
replaced collider never revives a retired wrapper
retiring a shared mesh removes geometry from every collider instance
